description: This is an abstract Java class for an Android Input Method Service, specifically for a custom keyboard implementation called 'AnySoftKeyboard'. It manages input views, handles configuration changes, key events, and interaction with the input connection, serving as a base class for more specific keyboard implementations.

classes.name: AnySoftKeyboardBase
classes.description: An abstract base class for an Android input method service implementing a custom keyboard, managing input views, configuration, and input connection interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, logs startup, sets orientation, starts tracing if requested, and obtains the input method manager.

methods.name: getInputView
methods.description: Returns the current input view binder.

methods.name: getInputViewContainer
methods.description: Returns the container view for the input view.

methods.name: getSettingsInputMethodId
methods.description: Abstract method to get the input method ID from settings.

methods.name: getInputMethodManager
methods.description: Returns the input method manager instance.

methods.name: onComputeInsets
methods.description: Adjusts the insets for the input method window, especially when not in fullscreen mode.

methods.name: sendDownUpKeyEvents
methods.description: Sends a key down and up event sequence for a specified key code and meta state.

methods.name: deleteLastCharactersFromInput
methods.description: Abstract method to delete a specified number of characters from the input.

methods.name: onAddOnsCriticalChange
methods.description: Handles critical changes in add-ons, typically hides the window.

methods.name: onCreateInputView
methods.description: Creates and initializes the input view and container, sets background, and watermark.

methods.name: setInputView
methods.description: Sets the input view and updates window layout parameters.

methods.name: updateFullscreenMode
methods.description: Updates the fullscreen mode and window layout parameters.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Handles configuration changes, updates add-ons, and detects orientation changes.

methods.name: getCurrentOrientation
methods.description: Returns the current device orientation.

methods.name: onOrientationChanged
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to handle orientation changes.

methods.name: updateSoftInputWindowLayoutParameters
methods.description: Adjusts the layout parameters of the soft input window and input area.

methods.name: updateLayoutHeightOf
methods.description: Helper to update the height of a window or view.

methods.name: updateLayoutGravityOf
methods.description: Helper to update the gravity of a view's layout parameters.

methods.name: generateWatermark
methods.description: Generates a list of watermark drawables for the input view.

methods.name: setupInputViewWatermark
methods.description: Sets the watermark on the input view.

methods.name: createInputViewContainer
methods.description: Inflates and returns the main keyboard layout container.

methods.name: handleCloseRequest
methods.description: Handles requests to close the input window; default returns false.

methods.name: hideWindow
methods.description: Requests the OS to hide all views of the keyboard.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: onFinishInput
methods.description: Resets state when input is finished.

methods.name: isSelectionUpdateDelayed
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if selection updates are delayed.

methods.name: getExtractedText
methods.description: Retrieves the current extracted text from the input connection.

methods.name: getCursorPosition
methods.description: Returns the current cursor position, using extracted text if update is delayed.

methods.name: onUpdateSelection
methods.description: Updates internal cursor and selection positions based on selection changes.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Handles cancellation of input, typically when user releases finger outside keys.
